checks.claim: Urban residential leases require a cash deposit equivalent to one month of rent; non-residential leases require two months
The refundable cash-deposit balance bears legal interest after one month from delivery of keys if it has not been returned
Horizontal-property agreement challenge periods are generally three months and one year for agreements contrary to law or statutes
A Registro de la Propiedad nota simple is informative and identifies current registered ownership and the nature, extent and limitations of registered rights
Rental-deposit administrative obligations are territorial and must be checked against the applicable autonomous-community rules rather than inferred from the national LAU alone
Andalusia changed its rental-deposit administrative regime with effect from 2026-01-24, so Andalusian cases require effective-date verification

limitations: This validates suitability as a maintained real-estate decision-support knowledge source, not every sentence exhaustively.
Registry, cadastral, urban-planning, autonomous-community, municipal, rent-control, deposit and tourist-rental facts must be rechecked live for each property and effective date.
Execution of reserved legal, notarial, registry, tax filing, signature or payment acts remains outside autonomous decision support.
